response.overview: Two years after the tragic Battle of Taco Town, news anchor Guy Guy finds his anti-corporate crusade derailed when the ruthless cereal conglomerate Time Loops International buys out his station. Driven by an insatiable appetite for conquest, Time Loops' megalomaniacal CEO CJO hires eccentric scientist William Schmeckle to build an interdimensional portal so he can invade and conquer the "real world." To stop CJO's multiversal expansion, Guy Guy forms an uneasy alliance with his former rival, The Chief, and the weary Sheriff Albuquerque to pull off a high-stakes prison heist, freeing the frozen leader Aiden Prime and assembling a clone army to fight back. As the boundaries of reality break down and the characters literally collide with their real-world creators, the ragtag resistance launches an all-out, absurdly chaotic assault against CJO's forces to destroy the portal before the multiverse falls to a cereal empire.
response.title: Guy Guy 4: Cereal Killers
